answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 43433 Country: India Title: Recitation of the holy Quran Question: I want to know from your prestigious institute that can I recite the holy Quran in English. I am unable to read Arabic language. Let me inform you that my father passed away on 11th Nov. 2012 and I recited the holy Quran in English but one of neighbor (he is also a qualified Maulana) objected that I should not read in English. In English the recitation does not solve our purpose. Is it true? So how can I read the holy Quran? The holy Quran is available in the market in so many languages but the pronunciation of Arabic and other languages is different. So chose the Quran of English meaning (like-allhamdalilla he rabbil alamin -oh Allah) you are the only one and I am giving to respect that you are the great maker of the huge orbit). Hope I have cleared my points. I expect your best solution. Answer ID: 43433 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 187/173/N=1434) It is not lawful to recite the holy Quran in any other language except Arabic. As it is not possible in any other language of the world to correctly pronounce all the words of the holy Quran with necessary rules; hence it will inevitably cause distortion in the words of the holy Quran which is haram. This ruling is agreed upon by the whole Ummah with no difference. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
